sys_hub_action_instance_v2.comment: Gets one page of project tasks from Xero (up to 500)
Looks for the SPM task already linked to this Xero task. Empty means the task is new.
Looks for an existing resource role with the task name. Roles are never created by this flow.
Looks for the rate line of this role in the agreed rate model. The line is matched by the role sys_id. Rate lines are never created by this flow.
Creates or updates the task from Xero.
Looks for any resource assignment of this task. If one exists, no new assignment is created.

sys_hub_sub_flow_instance_v2.comment: Checks the resource and the rate line for this task.

subflow.display_value: Xero - Validate Resource and Rate Line

sys_hub_flow_logic_instance_v2.comment: Returns 0 so the parent stops the loop.
If the task was created
Sends the page count back to the parent.
Repeats the steps below for each Xero task.
Resets the created tasks counter to 0 before this page is processed.
Adds 1 to the created tasks.
Returns the page count only if Xero answered.
If none is found:
Adds a RESOURCE ROLE line. The task is created without a role.
Reports the missing role only when the task is new.
Adds a RATE MODEL line. The task is created without a rate line.
Reports the missing rate line only when the role exists and the task is new.
If Xero failed:

Looks for any resource assignment of this task. If one exists, no new assignment is created.
Creates or updates the task from Xero.
Looks for an existing resource role with the task name. Roles are never created by this flow.
Looks for the rate line of this role in the agreed rate model. The line is matched by the role sys_id. Rate lines are never created by this flow.
Looks for the SPM task already linked to this Xero task. Empty means the task is new.

sys_hub_flow_logic_instance_v2.comment: Resets the created tasks counter to 0 before this page is processed.
Returns the page count only if Xero answered.
Adds a RESOURCE ROLE line. The task is created without a role.
Reports the missing rate line only when the role exists and the task is new.
Sends the page count back to the parent.
If Xero failed:
Returns 0 so the parent stops the loop.
Adds a RATE MODEL line. The task is created without a rate line.
If the task was created
Adds 1 to the created tasks.
If none is found:
Repeats the steps below for each Xero task.
Reports the missing role only when the task is new.
